title: 阿司匹林的实验室合成
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/12_Laboratory Synthesis of Aspirin.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/12_Laboratory Synthesis of Aspirin/src.py

points.K1: 第一次真正的有机合成

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，手里举着一个白色药片模型，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench, holds up a large white tablet model and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来合成阿司匹林。
overlay: 阿司匹林合成实验与安全

shots.scene: 锥形瓶、热水浴、抽滤漏斗、试管架四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a conical flask, a beaker water bath on a hot plate, a filter funnel and a rack of test tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 合成、提纯、检验，一步步来。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一盒空白包装的药片，好奇地看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank medicine box of white tablets and looks at it curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇：药片是怎么做出来的？

shots.scene: 小研指着实验台上的一瓶白色粉末
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a jar of white powder with a blank label on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：从水杨酸开始，自己做一次。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜和手套，站到实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and gloves and steps up to the lab bench.
shots.narration: 这是他第一次真正做有机合成。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先看原理，再看流程。

shots.section_title: 第一次真正的有机合成
shots.scene: 几个小分子积木拼成一个大分子
shots.prompt_en: Small molecule building blocks snap together into a larger molecule model. No people.
shots.narration: 这一次，我们要真正合成一个分子。
overlay: 第一次真正的有机合成

shots.section_title: 第一次真正的有机合成
shots.scene: 药片、塑料、生物分子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tablet, a plastic bottle and a DNA helix, each linked to a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 合成路线能造出药物、材料和生物分子。

shots.scene: 一盒空白包装的药片和阿司匹林结构式
shots.prompt_en: A blank medicine box with white tablets next to a simple structural formula. No people.
shots.narration: 阿司匹林能退热、止痛、抗炎。

shots.scene: 水杨酸结构加箭头变成阿司匹林结构
shots.prompt_en: Two simple structural formulas with an arrow between them; a small group is highlighted on the right one. No people.
shots.narration: 它的化学名叫乙酰水杨酸。

shots.scene: 箭头上方是酸酐图标，下方是催化剂小标
shots.prompt_en: A reaction arrow with a reagent bottle icon above it and a small catalyst badge below. No people.
shots.narration: 水杨酸和乙酸酐反应，浓硫酸作催化剂。

shots.scene: 羟基抓住乙酰基的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hydroxyl group on a ring reaching out and grabbing a small acetyl piece. No people.
shots.narration: 水杨酸的羟基接上一个乙酰基。

shots.scene: 三步流程图：烧瓶加热、晶体、试管
shots.prompt_en: A three-step flow chart: a heated flask, a pile of crystals, and a test tube. No people.
shots.narration: 流程三步：反应、提纯、检验。

shots.scene: 感叹号象形图和腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: An exclamation mark hazard pictogram and a corrosive hazard pictogram side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂有刺激性，浓硫酸腐蚀性极强。

shots.scene: 小研穿戴护目镜、实验服、手套站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in safety goggles, buttoned lab coat and gloves stands ready at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 全部防护穿戴好，才能开始。

shots.scene: 大烧杯装水放在电热板上
shots.prompt_en: A large beaker of water sits on an electric hot plate with a dial. No people.
shots.narration: 500毫升烧杯装水，电热板上加热。

shots.scene: 药匙取白色粉末放到天平上的称量纸
shots.prompt_en: A spatula transfers white powder onto weighing paper on a generic balance with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 称约2克水杨酸，放进125毫升锥形瓶。

shots.scene: 在空白数据表上记下数字的手
shots.prompt_en: A hand writes in a blank data sheet next to the balance. No people.
shots.narration: 准确质量要记在数据表上。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台上，向锥形瓶中加入液体
shots.prompt_en: At an open lab bench, the female graduate student in goggles and gloves adds liquid from a small graduated cylinder into a conical flask.
shots.narration: 加入5毫升乙酸酐。

shots.scene: 滴管向锥形瓶滴加几滴
shots.prompt_en: On the lab bench, a dropper adds a few drops into the conical flask. No people.
shots.narration: 再加5滴浓硫酸作催化剂。

shots.scene: 轻轻摇动锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand gently swirls the conical flask on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 摇一摇，让它们充分混合。

shots.scene: 直接放电热板打叉，放水浴打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a flask directly on a hot plate crossed out with a red X, and a flask in a water bath with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用水浴加热，比直接放电热板更均匀。

shots.scene: 铁架台夹住锥形瓶，部分浸入热水
shots.prompt_en: On the lab bench, a ring stand clamp holds the conical flask partly submerged in a beaker of warm water. No people.
shots.narration: 水温80到90度，夹住烧瓶部分浸入。

shots.scene: 温度计和计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and a timer icon beside the water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 保持大约10分钟。

shots.scene: 取出锥形瓶放在台面冷却
shots.prompt_en: The conical flask is lifted out of the bath and set on a heat-resistant pad to cool. No people.
shots.narration: 反应完取出，冷却到室温。

shots.scene: 瓶中出现白色晶体
shots.prompt_en: White needle-like crystals start to appear in the cooling flask. No people.
shots.narration: 冷下来，阿司匹林晶体会析出。

shots.scene: 玻璃棒轻刮瓶内壁
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod gently scratches the inner wall of the flask, tiny sparkles mark the spot. No people.
shots.narration: 不析晶，可用玻璃棒轻刮内壁。

shots.scene: 刮下的小颗粒周围长出晶体
shots.prompt_en: Tiny particles on the glass wall become seeds that crystals grow around. No people.
shots.narration: 刮下的微粒能帮晶体开始生长。

shots.scene: 通风柜内向烧瓶缓慢加冷水
shots.prompt_en: On the lab bench, cold water is added down the wall of the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 仍不析晶，加约10毫升冷水，反应也停。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶放进冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: The flask sits in a beaker filled with ice and water. No people.
shots.narration: 放进冰水浴约10分钟，析出完全。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置：布氏漏斗、抽滤瓶、真空泵
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum filtration setup: a white porcelain funnel on a clamped thick-walled flask connected by tubing to a small vacuum pump. No people.
shots.narration: 用布氏漏斗减压抽滤，收集晶体。

shots.scene: 洗瓶冲洗锥形瓶，倒入漏斗
shots.prompt_en: A wash bottle rinses the remaining crystals from the flask into the funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 用冷水冲洗烧瓶，产物全部转移。

shots.scene: 冷水淋洗漏斗中的晶体
shots.prompt_en: Cold water is sprinkled over the crystals in the funnel and drawn through. No people.
shots.narration: 冷水还能洗去晶体表面的杂质。

shots.scene: 抽气一会儿，晶体变干
shots.prompt_en: The crystals in the funnel look dry and powdery as air is pulled through. No people.
shots.narration: 继续抽一会儿，把晶体抽干。

shots.scene: 产物转入贴空白标签的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The crystals are scraped into a beaker with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 把产物转到另一个容器。

shots.scene: 用少量乙醇冲洗滤纸
shots.prompt_en: A little ethanol rinses the filter paper into the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 滤纸上残留的，用少量乙醇冲下来。

shots.scene: 放大镜下晶体中夹着少量杂质颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, white crystals with a few odd-colored specks among them. No people.
shots.narration: 这时的粗品，还混着少量原料。

shots.scene: 重结晶循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon around a crystal symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 需要重结晶来提纯。

shots.scene: 粗品加少量乙醇溶解
shots.prompt_en: A little ethanol is added to the crude crystals in a beaker on the lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 先用约5毫升乙醇溶解粗品。

shots.scene: 加入热水，放电热板上加热
shots.prompt_en: Warm water is added and the beaker is warmed on a hot plate on the lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 再加约50毫升热水，放电热板上加热。

shots.scene: 补加溶剂直到全部溶解
shots.prompt_en: More solvent is added little by little until the solution is completely clear. No people.
shots.narration: 边加热边补溶剂，直到全部溶解。

shots.scene: 烧杯离开电热板，静置
shots.prompt_en: The beaker is moved off the hot plate onto a pad to cool at room temperature. No people.
shots.narration: 离开热源，室温下慢慢析晶。

shots.scene: 必要时刮壁，之后放冰浴
shots.prompt_en: A glass rod scratches the wall, then the beaker is placed in an ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 可以刮壁诱导，最后再放冰浴。

shots.scene: 天平上称表面皿和滤纸
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass with a folded filter paper on a generic balance with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 再次抽滤前，先称表面皿和滤纸。

shots.scene: 同一张滤纸放进漏斗抽滤
shots.prompt_en: The same filter paper is placed in the funnel and the crystals are filtered and pulled dry. No people.
shots.narration: 用这张滤纸抽滤，再抽干。

shots.scene: 带晶体的滤纸放在表面皿上
shots.prompt_en: The filter paper with white crystals rests on the watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 把产物放在表面皿上干燥。

shots.scene: 室温晾干或放入烘箱
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a watch glass on a bench with a clock, and a small lab oven. No people.
shots.narration: 室温晾干，或65度烘箱烘20分钟。

shots.scene: 称量，减法公式卡
shots.prompt_en: The dried product is weighed, and a card shows one box minus another box. No people.
shots.narration: 称总重，减去皮重，就是产物质量。

shots.scene: 白色晶体旁浮现问号
shots.prompt_en: A watch glass of white crystals with a question mark floating above. No people.
shots.narration: 做出来的，真是阿司匹林吗？

shots.scene: 熔点仪、光谱、薄层板、试管四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a melting point apparatus, a spectrum chart, a small plate with spots, and a test tube. No people.
shots.narration: 常用熔点、光谱、薄层色谱等方法。

shots.scene: 试管图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A test tube icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这次用一个简单的显色试验。

shots.scene: 滴管滴入红棕色溶液，试管变紫
shots.prompt_en: A dropper adds reddish-brown liquid into a tube, and the tube turns purple. No people.
shots.narration: 三氯化铁遇到酚羟基，会变成紫色。

shots.scene: 两个结构式，一个的酚羟基被高亮
shots.prompt_en: Two simple structural formulas; a group on the left one is highlighted, the right one has no such group. No people.
shots.narration: 水杨酸有酚羟基，阿司匹林没有。

shots.scene: 左管紫色、右管棕色
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes: the left one purple, the right one brownish. No people.
shots.narration: 所以水杨酸变紫，阿司匹林不变色。

shots.scene: 产物管变紫，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A product tube turns purple with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 产物若变紫，说明没做成或没除净原料。

shots.scene: 试管架上四支试管，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A rack holds four test tubes with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 检验设四支试管。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜手套，向每支试管滴加试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves adds a few drops of reagent to each tube.
shots.narration: 纯水作对照，确认试验本身可靠。

shots.scene: 原料管变成深紫色
shots.prompt_en: The first tube turns deep purple. No people.
shots.narration: 原料管变紫，和预期一致。

shots.scene: 粗品管轻微变色
shots.prompt_en: The second tube shows a faint purple tint. No people.
shots.narration: 粗品可能变紫，说明还有残留原料。

shots.scene: 纯品管保持棕黄色，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The third tube stays yellowish-brown, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 纯品不变色，合成和提纯都成功。

shots.scene: 对照管不变色，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The water control tube stays unchanged, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 对照管不变，说明检验有效。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰看着表面皿上的白色晶体，开心击掌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student, both in goggles, high-five beside a watch glass of white crystals.
shots.narration: 这是最简单的合成，后面还有更多。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现反应式、晶体和试管图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a reaction arrow, crystals and test tubes.
shots.narration: 酸酐乙酰化，结晶提纯，显色检验。

shots.scene: 水浴、冰浴、抽滤三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water bath, an ice bath and a vacuum filtration funnel. No people.
shots.narration: 水浴加热，冰浴析晶，抽滤收集。

shots.scene: 天平、表面皿、滤纸图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a balance, a watch glass and a filter paper. No people.
shots.narration: 干燥称量，减去皮重得产量。

shots.scene: 四支试管：紫、浅紫、棕、无色图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four test tubes: deep purple, faint purple, brown and clear. No people.
shots.narration: 三氯化铁不变紫，产物就纯了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy lab bench with a watch glass of white crystals.
shots.narration: 合成有乐趣，下次学更多，再见！
